meta.description: Raw Chebyshev (SPK type 2) states from de421.bsp evaluated with jplephem, one entry per segment, no chaining.  Positions in km, velocities in km/s, ICRF/J2000 axes, relative to the segment centre.
meta.method: seg = SPK.open(de421.bsp)[center, target]; pos_km, vel_km_per_day = seg.compute_and_differentiate(2451545.0, et/86400.0); velocity_km_s = vel_km_per_day / 86400.  jplephem internally forms seconds = (tdb - 2451545.0)*86400 + tdb2*86400, so the evaluation epoch is exactly et seconds (TDB) past J2000 up to one rounding of et/86400*86400.
meta.et_definition: TDB seconds past J2000 (JD 2451545.0 TDB).  et = (JD_0h - 2451545.0)*86400 + seconds-of-day; both terms are exact integers in double precision.
